eventMetadata.context_description: No. 3 seed Illinois entered the Elite Eight matchup against Big Ten rival No. 9 seed Iowa as the trader-favored side in this South Regional showdown at Houston's Toyota Center, buoyed by superior seeding, dominant frontcourt play from freshman standout Keaton Wagler, and a lopsided 10-1 head-to-head edge over the past 11 meetings, capped by a 75-69 regular-season victory. Iowa's Cinderella tournament run featured a gritty Sweet 16 upset over Nebraska, powered by point guard Bennett Stirtz and versatile wings like Kael Combs and Cooper Koch, but lacked the size to counter Illinois' interior advantages. No major injury updates disrupted rotations in the final 24 hours, with both squads at full strength amid neutral-site conditions and high March Madness stakes for a Final Four berth.
